params.1273: Speak to Horacio, the Duke of Lumbridge.
params.1274: The Duke of Lumbridge can be found in his bedroom in Lumbridge Castle.
params.1275: Enter the castle and make your way to one of the staircases, either to the north or south.
params.1276: Climb the staircase to the first floor. Head down the corridor and enter the Duke's bedroom.
params.1277: Speak to the Duke to introduce yourself.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
